# RFC 8785 fixtures

These data-only fixtures are byte oracles, not serializer output generated by a
test. They cover RFC 8785 property ordering, Unicode UTF-8, control escapes,
ECMAScript numeric serialization, nesting, and arrays. The Unicode/number/order
cases are vendored from RFC 8785-compatible JCS vectors; `canonical.utf8.hex` is
the normative UTF-8 byte sequence and `sha256.txt` hashes those exact bytes.
